title: Technical Product Manager
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice
  
  
**Team Overview**
What: we drive credit risk solution delivery as technical product managers
  
  
How: we deliver new products to market, enhance existing products, modernize our platforms and products, and innovate new technical solutions for customers
  
  
Who: Technical product mangement leader will be Carla Leatherman This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
  
  
**Overview**
**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**
We are seeking a Technical Product Manager, Advisor to own technical delivery and application outcomes for a major product area or program workstream. You will translate strategy into a feasible 2–3 PI roadmap and lead multiple teams through design, build, testing, release, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  
  
This role may support real-time products and partners with Solutions, Data Science, Analytics, Compliance, Engineering, and Operations to deliver scalable credit risk solutions.
  
  
Success requires technical fluency, concise communication, independent judgment, and influence across a complex matrix. The TPM Advisor aligns partners, manages dependencies, and escalates issues with clear options and trade-offs.
  
  
**Why the role exists:**
Turn product strategy into coordinated technical delivery for complex, multi-team initiatives, specifically for our online credit risk products.
  
  
**Outcomes it drives:**
Predictable delivery, scalable and compliant solutions, stronger adoption, reliability, customer value, and growth.
  
  
**What the person owns:**
The roadmap, priorities, dependencies, risks, cross-functional decisions, release readiness, launch, and continuous improvement for online credit risk products.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
**Required Knowledge And Experiences**
**Workstream Strategy & Delivery Leadership**

* Translate strategy into a feasible, KPI-aligned roadmap for a major workstream across multiple teams and 2–3 PIs.
* Own priorities, sequencing, capacity assumptions, delivery waterlines, dependencies, and readiness criteria.
* Lead strategic Alternative Credit initiatives, including Alternative Data, Blended Scores, integrations, compliance, modernization, and customer onboarding.
* Resolve competing priorities using customer value, impact, risk, feasibility, urgency, and opportunity cost.
* Maintain predictable delivery by surfacing trade-offs and driving timely corrective action.

**Cross Functional Program Leadership**

* Lead complex delivery across Solutions, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Compliance, Operations, Architecture, Customer Success, and support teams.
* Turn roadmap commitments into outcome-based plans with clear milestones, owners, forecasts, dependencies, and success measures.
* Manage cross-team risks, impediments, and decisions; escalate with clear options, impacts, and recommendations.
* Establish planning, forecasting, risk-review, and KPI cadences that improve transparency and accountability.
* Provide stakeholders clear visibility into delivery health, changes, and corrective actions.

**Product Development Lifecycle Ownership**

* Own delivery from discovery and commitment through launch, adoption, and iteration.
* Maintain traceability across outcomes, roadmap commitments, requirements, delivery plans, releases, and results.
* Re-plan using customer feedback, KPIs, regulatory changes, risk, capacity, and readiness.
* Lead discovery, requirements, and solution trade-offs for complex, high-visibility initiatives.
* Ensure regulatory, model-governance, audit, data-quality, operational, and customer requirements are met.

**Quality, Risk & Operational Readiness**

* Lead workstream-level delivery, technical, operational, security, compliance, regulatory, and customer risk management.
* Maintain mitigation plans, escalation paths, release gates, readiness reviews, and clear accountability across teams.
* Balance timeline, scope, quality, technical debt, and operational risk in delivery recommendations.
* Partner with engineering to monitor reliability, defects, stability, and post-launch outcomes.
* Use root-cause analysis and lessons learned to reduce recurring issues and rework.

**Technical Expectations**
The Technical Product Manager understands application architecture, data flows, integration patterns, cloud constraints, and operational considerations well enough to guide delivery decisions with engineering.
  
  

* Partner with engineering and architecture on application design, implementation, testing, documentation, and operational readiness.
* Guide data-processing and integration decisions involving data movement, performance, resilience, debugging, and environment readiness.
* Partner with Data Science and Analytics to productionize models, features, score workflows, monitoring, and performance measures.
* Balance customer value, compliance, reliability, scalability, time to value, and technical debt.
* Communicate requirements, decisions, risks, trade-offs, and status clearly to technical teams and leaders.

**Leadership Expectations**
Lead through influence and ambiguity, align teams on priorities and trade-offs, and operate independently while strengthening delivery practices and outcomes.
  
  

* Set clear workstream priorities and delivery guardrails while empowering teams to execute.
* Build commitment through evidence, transparency, and clear trade-offs.
* Influence stakeholders without direct authority and maintain alignment through change.
* Coach junior TPMs and partner teams on planning, execution, risk, and accountability.

**Qualifications**

* Typically 8+ years in technical product management, application development, engineering, systems analysis, or data-processing delivery, including ownership of a major workstream across multiple teams.
* Bachelor’s degree required; financial services, insurance, or banking experience preferred.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum or SAFe delivery from requirements through post-launch adoption.
* Proven ability to translate strategy into a KPI-aligned 2–3 PI roadmap with priorities, capacity, waterlines, dependencies, and trade-offs.
* Demonstrated ownership of multi-team execution, credible forecasts, cross-functional decisions, and corrective action.
* Experience leading risk, quality, release, and operational readiness, including evidence-based escalation and post-launch improvement.
* Strong technical partnership skills across application design, data processing, integrations, cloud platforms, performance, resiliency, and operational readiness.
* Clear written and verbal communication for business, technical, and senior leadership audiences.
* Ability to influence without authority and strengthen the practices of junior TPMs and partner teams.
* Preferred: Experience with credit risk, consumer reporting, FCRA, model governance, alternative data, scores or predictive models, cloud modernization, and GCP or AWS in an online environment; SAFe PO/PM or related certification.

**Expectations in the First 90 Days**

* Learn the product strategy, application ecosystem, delivery model, FactorTrust platform, Alternative Data products, Blended Scores, customer use cases, and regulatory context.
* Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Compliance, Operations, Legal, Marketing, and Customer Success.
* Assess the roadmap, delivery health, dependencies, quality controls, and operational risks; recommend an initial 2–3 PI plan.
* Establish a multi-team cadence for planning, forecasting, risk review, decisions, KPI reporting, ownership, and escalation.

**What You’ll Accomplish Beyond 90 Days**

* Independently lead discovery, solution design, delivery, testing, release, and adoption for complex initiatives.
* Own a feasible, KPI-aligned roadmap and delivery waterline across multiple teams and 2–3 PIs.
* Drive Alternative Credit and FactorTrust initiatives from concept through production, including compliance and modernization work.
* Lead quality, risk, release, and operational readiness; identify exposure early and drive mitigation.
* Deliver measurable improvements in customer value, adoption, reliability, compliance, efficiency, and growth.
* Introduce reusable planning, forecasting, governance, and readiness practices

**TransUnion Overview**
At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our
**Workforce for Good**
, which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.
  
  
Be a part of our
**Workforce for Good**
– you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.

Advisor, Product Management

title: Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview**
Data, Reporting & Operations Management (DROM) Data & Modeling team drives operational excellence across Global Operations by ensuring data integrity, model governance, and actionable insights. We combine advanced analytics, forecasting, and control frameworks to enable fact-based decision-making and operational transparency.
  
  
**Job Description**
This role leads complex analysis and analytical product development to minimize loss exposure and elevate the customer experience at scale for Data & Modeling team. The experienced Senior Data Analyst & Developer sets the vision for data-driven decisioning within Global Operations owning the analytics roadmap, establishing governance and quality standards, and influencing enterprise policy and segmentation strategies to produce optimal results. You will leverage PowerShell, JavaScript, Alteryx, Python, SQL, Tableau and other approved relational databases to design scalable automation, drive operational performance and guide long-term strategy. This role partners closely with Product Management to ensure reporting standards, controls, and enterprise governance are not only met but consistently exceeded. You’ll act as a thought leader, coach, and trusted advisor to peers, clients and executive management, balancing short-term delivery with long-term platform and data product resilience.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
Strategy & Thought Leadership
  
  

* Define and own part of the analytics strategy and roadmap; align priorities to business outcomes and risk appetite.
* Establish and champion data governance, quality, and control frameworks; ensure audit readiness and model risk considerations are embedded in solutions.
* Translate enterprise goals into measurable KPIs; drive adoption, usage, and value realization across functions.
* Identify and evaluate emerging tooling (within Bank-approved technologies) to improve scalability, performance, and cost effectiveness.

Product & Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Lead the design, development, and operational ownership of reporting suites and dashboards; drive standardization across team.
* Architect and enforce coding standards, peer reviews, change impact practices, and documentation that enable reliable, repeatable delivery.
* Prioritize a portfolio of initiatives; apply intake triage, sequencing, and dependency management to meet established timelines.
* Champion scalable solutions; modernize legacy processes into resilient, sustainable data products.

Risk, Performance & Decisioning
  
  

* Recommends ways to help the business achieve desired outcomes and make informed business decisions using data analysis outputs with clear decision frameworks and control points.
* Performs complex analysis of operational data, staffing data, financial data, and portfolio trends to improve portfolio risk, profitability, forecasting accuracy, and operational performance and socializes insights with executive-ready narratives.
* Leads coordination of the production of product performance reports and updates for senior management including scenario analysis, sensitivity testing, and forward-looking risk mitigations.
* Evaluate data to assess potential risk and create proactive mitigation strategies, escalation process and remediation plans.

Stakeholder & Change Leadership
  
  

* Serve as the primary analytics liaison to Product Management and senior leadership; influence outcomes through data-backed storytelling.
* Drive cross-functional change management, ensuring business readiness, training, and adoption for new dashboards, metrics, and processes.
* Facilitate governance forums and decision gates; ensure alignment to enterprise policy, regulatory requirements, and control frameworks.

People Development & Culture
  
  

* Coach, mentor, and upskill other analysts and developers within GORA; foster a culture of curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Lead communities of practice for analytics engineering and visualization; codify best practices and reusable assets.
* Model inclusive collaboration; create psychological safety for ideation, peer review, and constructive challenge.

**Requirements:**
**Education:**
Bachelor’s in Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
  
  

* Certifications: Agile/Scaled Agile methodology (Scrum, SAFe); (preferred)

**Experience Range:**
5+ years in a Development, Data Analytics, Automation
  
  
**Foundational Skills**- 5+ years in Data Analytics, Process/Project Management or a similar role in the financial services industry; proven leadership of cross-functional analytics initiatives.
- Demonstrated ability to define standards and enforce governance across reporting, documentation, and audit requirements.
- Talent for combining business acumen with analytical rigor; interpret large datasets, synthesize multiple analyses, and translate into actionable executive insights.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and complex portfolios; apply prioritization frameworks to meet delivery commitments.
- Advanced oral and written communication; influence outcomes across diverse stakeholder groups and leadership levels.
- Proficient in independent work and team leadership; drive on-time delivery with precision and accountability.
- Create, review, and monitor requirement documents to support repeatability, business continuity, governance, audit requirements and maintain versioned artifacts.
- Stay current with the latest developments in Bank of America-approved software and applications; assess fit-for-purpose against enterprise standards.
- Expert in 4 or more of the following:

* JavaScript
* Tableau (including governance, permissions and performance optimization)
* PowerShell
* SQL (query optimization, data modeling and controls)
* Alteryx (Server workflows, scheduling and governance)
* Python (packaging, testing and reproducibility)
* PowerQuery
* Nintex
* PowerApps
* MicroSoft Power Apps
* Strategic & Analytical Thinking: Systems-level thinking, hypothesis-driven analysis, and portfolio-level prioritization.
* Executive Storytelling & Influence: Clear narratives that connect insights to outcomes; strong negotiation and alignment skills.
* Collaboration & Stakeholder Management: Builds trust across product, operations, risk, and technology; manages competing priorities.
* Change Leadership: Guides teams through adoption of new tools, metrics, and processes; reduces friction and ensures readiness.
* Coaching & Mentorship: Develops talent, conducts thorough code/analysis reviews, and encourages learning culture.
* Problem Solving & Critical Thinking: Frames complex problems, tests assumptions, and validates outcomes with controls.
* Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Identifies opportunities for automation, reusability, and pattern standardization.

**Desired Skills**

* Bachelor’s in Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
* Knowledge of Agile/Scaled Agile methodology (Scrum, SAFe); experience as a Product Owner or Delivery Lead is a plus.
* Business understanding of Global Operations, including risk frameworks, operational efficiency, and customer experience drivers.
* Experience with data governance frameworks, control testing, and audit readiness; familiarity with model risk and policy impacts.
* Lean Six Sigma or process excellence credentials: track record of measurable efficiency gains in operations analytics.
* Experience administering Tableau Server / Alteryx Server and managing enterprise content lifecycles.

**Work Timings:**
12:30 PM – 9:30 PM (need to be flexible)
  
  
**Job Location:**
Mumbai/ Chennai/Gift

title: Quantum Treasury Implementation - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Finance Transformation**
Join our Finance Transformation practice to help Deloitte client service teams define and execute Finance and Global Business Services agendas and strategies. You will work with world-class teams and insights, helping support delivery in challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to help unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we collaborate with teams to enable transforming finance.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level:**
Senior Consultant or equivalent
  
  
As an experienced Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
You’ll implement FIS Quantum modules—including Cash Management, Investments, Intercompany, Debt, and FX—for large multinational firms, configuring each to address complex structures. You’ll establish secure banking connectivity via SWIFT and Host-to-Host, and rigorously test integrations. Responsibilities include preparing business requirements documents, blueprints, status reports, and updates, as well as providing go-live support and resolving post-implementation client queries to ensure smooth operations and high client satisfaction.

title: CREWS Digitalization - Associate Director
description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**
Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
  
  
At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose – always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping future of business.
  
  
**About The Role**
As Associate Director – CREWS Digitalization, you will be a key member of the CREWS leadership ecosystem, collaborating with global and regional CRE leaders, Legal & Corporate Administration, Finance, Procurement, Security, EHS, BCM, Risk, enterprise technology teams and vendor partners.
  
  
You will define and deliver the digital strategy, roadmap and technology lifecycle for CREWS platforms such as IWMS/CAFM, CMMS, smart workplace, IoT, analytics and self-service BI. This role provides the autonomy to standardize processes, improve workplace experience, strengthen sustainability reporting and create data-driven operational outcomes across the portfolio.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Define the 2–3 year CREWS digital strategy and investment roadmap aligned to business priorities, enterprise architecture and cybersecurity standards.
* Build business cases, TCO/ROI models, stage-gate approvals and prioritization frameworks for high-impact digital use cases.
* Re-engineer CREWS processes across facilities operations, space management, lease administration, projects, sustainability/ESG, health & safety and workplace services.
* Lead selection, implementation and enhancement of IWMS/CAFM, CMMS, digital twins, IoT/sensors, visitor/room booking and field mobility solutions.
* Establish a unified data model, integrations and data governance across CREWS platforms and enterprise systems including HR, Finance, Procurement and Security.
* Operationalize KPIs/OKRs, dashboards and advanced analytics for predictive maintenance, occupancy optimization, energy optimization and SLA compliance.
* Run multi-release Agile/Hybrid programs, managing internal squads, external partners, vendor performance, SLAs, contracts and value realization.
* Drive change, communications, training and adoption across global sites while championing user-centric design, experimentation and continuous improvement.
* Embrace our vibrant culture by striving for excellence, focusing on meaningful outcomes, and collaborating effectively. Take ownership, build relationships, and focus on personal growth to drive business strategy and foster an inclusive culture, creating unmatched career opportunities and impactful work.

**What You Must Have To Be Considered**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Facilities/Real Estate or a related field; Master’s/MBA preferred.
* Extensive experience in CRE, Workplace, Facilities Management digitalization, workplace technology or enterprise transformation across multi-site/global portfolios.
* Strong platform leadership experience in IWMS/CAFM/CMMS, workplace applications, smart building, IoT analytics or related enterprise platforms at scale.
* Strong understanding of facilities operations, space and occupancy management, projects, lease administration, service desk, vendor management, EHS and sustainability/ESG reporting.
* Proven ability to manage digital programs, business cases, TCO/ROI, governance approvals, vendor commercials, contract performance and benefit realization.
* Solid knowledge of data modeling, integrations, APIs, BI dashboards, data governance, data quality, lineage and enterprise reporting practices.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity, privacy, RBAC, SSO, encryption, vulnerability management, auditability and segregation-of-duties controls.
* A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes and passion for work that serves customers, communities and business outcomes.
* Embodiment of Cognizant’s values: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do the Right Thing and Own It.

**These will help you succeed**

* Hands-on exposure to platforms such as Planon, Archibus, TRIRIGA, Nuvolo or equivalent IWMS/CAFM solutions.
* Familiarity with BMS/BAS, room/desk booking, visitor management, digital twin platforms and field mobility solutions.
* Knowledge of IoT sensors for occupancy, IAQ and energy, along with edge gateways, device management, OPC, Modbus or BACnet concepts.
* Exposure to RPA, workflow engines, ML models for predictive maintenance or occupancy optimization and GenAI assistants for knowledge/service desk use cases.
* Working knowledge of Power BI/Tableau, SQL, ETL/iPaaS, APIs and integration patterns such as Kafka/ESB.
* Experience partnering with Sustainability teams to digitize energy, water, waste and emissions-related reporting where applicable.
* Executive presence, concise communication style and ability to influence CRE, Finance, HR, Security, Procurement, site operations and vendor stakeholders.

**Key interfaces**

* General Counsel – India & APAC
* Global and Regional CRE Leadership
* Legal, Ethics & Compliance
* Finance & FP&A
* Procurement & Vendor Management
* Security, EHS, BCM and Risk teams

**Key outcomes and KPIs – first 12–18 months**
**Outcome area**
**Expected impact / KPI**
**Operational efficiency**
15–25% reduction in reactive work orders through predictive maintenance; 10–20% reduction in vendor management cycle times through workflow automation.
  
  
**Workplace Experience**
20% improvement in booking utilization and frictionless access; 10-point improvement in Workplace NPS/CSAT for digitized services.
  
  
**Data quality and insights**
95%+ completeness/accuracy across space, assets and leases; executive dashboards live for portfolio, OPEX/Capex, energy and SLA/contract performance.
  
  
**Sustainability**
5–10% energy reduction in targeted sites through sensor-driven optimization; digitized ESG reporting for CREWS scope including energy, water, waste and applicable emissions.
  
  
**Adoption and change**
80–90% active usage of key modules post go-live; 95% training completion for impacted roles.
  
  
**Financials**
Realized savings tracked against business case with payback delivered within target window.
  
  
**Core competencies**

* Product & Program Leadership: Roadmapping, backlog prioritization, release management and value tracking.
* Stakeholder Management: Engages CRE leaders, Finance, HR, IT Security, Procurement, site operations and vendors.
* Change Management: Communications, training, adoption metrics and user-centric design.
* Financial Acumen: TCO/ROI modeling, vendor commercials and benefit tracking.
* Problem Solving: Systems thinking, data-driven decision-making and structured execution.
* Communication: Clear, concise and credible communication with executive presence.

Agile Methodology, Collaboration, Communication, Demand Forecasting, Execution Focus, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Product Costing, Product Development, Product Strategies, Quality Assurance (QA), Research and Development, Researching, Software Development Management, Technical Credibility, Technical Writing, Technologically Savvy

title: Functional Lead

title: Biz Development
description:
Business Development Manager
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Business Development Manager, you will make an impact by leading pre-sales and business pursuit efforts, including RFPs, RFIs, client presentations, pricing inputs, proposal development, and go-to-market support. You will be a valued member of the Business Development team and work collaboratively with sales, account teams, solution design teams, commercial teams, technology stakeholders, and other cross-functional groups to support winning business outcomes.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own and manage business pursuit efforts, including RFPs, RFIs, presentations, proposals, pricing inputs, estimations, and related sales collateral.
* Partner with sales, account, technical, solution design, commercial, transition, consulting, and professional services teams to manage stakeholder expectations throughout the pursuit cycle.
* Identify market trends, customer pain points, competitive positioning, and business opportunities to strengthen Cognizant's value proposition.
* Create and maintain reusable proposal components, marketing collateral, case studies, white papers, solution accelerators, brochures, and client-facing presentations.
* Support client visits, competency presentations, knowledge management initiatives, and business development activities that improve response quality and accelerate time-to-market.

Work model
  
  
We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring associates to work from a client or Cognizant office as needed based on business and project requirements. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
What you need to have to be considered
  
  

* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification.
* Experience in business development, pre-sales, bid management, proposal development, or pursuit management within the IT services industry.
* Experience responding to RFPs and RFIs and developing compelling client-focused proposals.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across sales, consulting, solution design, technology, commercial, and delivery teams.
* Experience with pricing, estimation, profitability analysis, and business pursuit management.
* Excellent communication, presentation, business analysis, and problem-solving skills.

These will help you stand out
  
  

* Experience developing reusable proposal assets, case studies, white papers, solution accelerators, and marketing collateral.
* Strong understanding of customer landscapes, technology investments, industry trends, and competitive positioning.
* Experience supporting client visits, executive presentations, and sales enablement initiatives.
* Ability to identify new business opportunities and contribute to solution and service development.
* Experience mentoring team members and contributing to knowledge-sharing initiatives.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

description:
**Description**
Do you love to read? Are you inspired by how to make written content easy and delightful to consume on Kindle? If the answer is yes, you have the opportunity to inspire millions of customers to read more. Kindle is among the bestselling products in the history of Amazon, with a rich legacy for driving customer-focused innovation. Our continued growth requires leaders who operate both strategically and tactically; think big to drive new opportunities; dive deep in data to uncover customer insights; break down and solve complex problems; and drive operational excellence.
  
  
This position is for our Kindle Content Experience team, whose mission is to provide superior reading experience for all eBooks on Kindle devices and applications by partnering with publishers and authors. We strive to build and enhance mechanisms to enable publishers and authors create eBooks with the right layouts, typography and fonts for a great and coherent experience across devices.
  
  
As a Senior Product Manager (Technical), you will define, execute, and deliver a product roadmap with the goal of earning the trust of our publishers and authors to deliver the best experience for our reading customers. You will strongly influence the strategy and vision for the group. You will develop and look after product roadmaps and features based on team strategy and vision. This role is inherently cross-functional -- you will work closely with engineering, business, operations, vendor management and executive teams to launch features and build tools and mechanisms. A successful candidate will be highly analytical, able to work extremely effectively in a matrix organization, and adept at synthesizing a variety of technologies and capabilities into high quality, simple product, features and applications.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Assist in driving and delivering the best content experience on all Kindle surfaces.
* Lead cross-functional teams (engineering, UX, research, etc.) across Amazon and Books to deliver projects on time.
* Support in defining strategic, creative, high quality product roadmaps based on team strategy and vision supported by internal and external analysis.
* Learn from customer feedback, behavioral measurements, and other data sources to craft better experiences and ensure we are building the right features over time.
* Role is global in nature and will work with teams in other countries.

**About The Team**
The KINEX (Kindle Experience) team owns the overall experience for the Kindle for iOS app, Kindle for Android app, FireOS, E-reader, Kindle for web, PC/Mac, Kindle File Format for Books & Documents, Content Experiences and Publisher Tools. This includes much of the experience you see on the app (Library, Home, Settings, Insights, etc.) and inside of the book (Core content presentation, Audio books consumption, Aa menu, other chrome), but does not include Store detail page/search and the publishing and subscription side of the business (KDP, KU, etc.).
  
  
Our mission is to make Kindle the world's favorite way to read and get more out of reading. Our vision for Kindle is a magical piece of paper that empowers customers to engage with and reflect on the written word.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative/technical field such as computer science, engineering, statistics
* 5+ years of professional experience with 2+ years of consumer/enterprise facing product management experience
* Experience working with cross-functional teams to deliver products and projects on tight deadlines
* Experience coordinating product development cycles and software development schedules

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA
* BS in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field from a top university
* Experience delivering consumer software products and services in a high growth environment
* Experience in technical product management, program management or engineering
* Strong verbal/written communication and data presentation skills, including an ability to effectively communicate with both business and technical teams
* Prior experience working in a software engineering discipline
* Passion for reading

title: Manager, Product Management — Sourcing & Procurement
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Manager, Product Management — Sourcing & Procurement**
**Zora AI™ by Deloitte | Deloitte Consulting Products (USI)**
**About The Role**
Zora AI™ by Deloitte is Deloitte's agentic AI platform, delivering role- and function-specific products — including Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Customer, and Human Capital — built on the NVIDIA AI stack and underpinned by Deloitte's Trustworthy AI™ framework.
  
  
Deloitte is looking for a hands-on Product Manager to own the
**Sourcing & Procurement product area**
within Zora AI end-to-end. Based in US-India (USI Office), you'll own the roadmap, the team, and the outcomes for a defined slice of the procurement portfolio — spanning requisitioning, sourcing and RFx, contract management, supplier onboarding and collaboration, and purchase-to-pay — turning real practitioner pain points into digital workers that deliver measurable value. You'll set direction in partnership with the Product Lead, run discovery and delivery across multiple workstreams, and bring deep procurement domain expertise to every decision, all while ensuring trust, adoption, and business impact for enterprise users.

You'll work closely with US-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders, and you'll mentor and grow the Consultants and Analysts around you.

* Own the roadmap, backlog, and outcomes for the Sourcing & Procurement product area, and take a lead role — alongside the Product Lead — in shaping the 12–18 month vision and strategy
* Make prioritization and trade-off calls across multiple workstreams (requisition, sourcing/RFx, contract management, supplier onboarding, purchase-to-pay), sequencing by value, effort, and readiness
* Define and own the KPIs that prove impact: adoption, efficiency gains, cost reduction, supplier performance, and workflow completion
* Know when something isn't working — flag it early, make the case to change course, and retire low-value work fast

**Discover & Validate**

* Lead discovery to understand procurement practitioners, category managers, and finance stakeholders, and translate what you hear into prioritized, high-value use cases
* Frame and test hypotheses through user research, prototypes, and competitive analysis of procurement platforms before committing to build at scale
* Use generative and evaluative research to continuously answer "are we building the right thing?" and "are we building it right?"

**Ship as One Team**

* Take features and agent capabilities from concept through define, shape, build, and scale

* Own launch, adoption, and iteration — instrument the product and act on what the telemetry and voice-of-customer data show
* Work in an AI-native way, using AI and agentic workflows across discovery, build, and delivery

**Trust & Governance**

* Partner with risk, compliance, and cybersecurity teams to define evaluation approach, monitoring plans, auditability, and governance requirements aligned to the Trustworthy AI™ framework
* Own trust and audit-readiness outcomes for your product area, including policy adherence and reduction of high-severity model risks

**Clients & Go-to-Market**

* Stay close to clients — lead demos, discovery sessions, and feedback conversations with procurement leaders and category managers, and turn what you hear into roadmap decisions
* Own go-to-market inputs for your area: positioning, pricing/packaging input, demos, and enablement, partnering with sales, alliances, and delivery on pursuits, pilots, and launches

**Work Across the Network & Lead the Team**

* Partner with Deloitte Consulting Delivery and Practice teams across India to align the product area with delivery capacity and real client needs
* Mentor and develop the Consultants and Analysts on your team, raising the bar on product craft, and act as the go-to escalation point for your product area
* Collaborate with Sourcing & Procurement SMEs to collect product feedback and establish an advisory council

**Key Deliverables**

* Owned roadmap and delivery for the Sourcing & Procurement product area, with direct input into broader portfolio strategy
* PRDs, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria across all agent capabilities in your area
* Use-case catalog and prioritization framework (value, feasibility, risk, readiness)
* MVP/pilot plans with success metrics, rollout phases, and scale criteria
* Trust & governance artifacts: evaluation approach, monitoring plan, audit/logging requirements
* Release plans and launch-readiness inputs (docs, training, demo scripts, enablement)
* Customer feedback loop: telemetry dashboards, voice-of-customer insights, iteration plan
* Development plans and coaching cadence for direct reports/mentees

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Adoption: active users, repeat usage, workflow completion rates, feature utilization
* Business impact: cycle-time reduction, cost-to-serve/spend reduction, supplier performance and exception-resolution improvements
* Quality & reliability: task success rate, low rework/rollback rates, latency/uptime, healthy incident trends
* Trust & compliance: audit readiness, policy adherence, governance review outcomes
* Delivery excellence: roadmap predictability, on-time releases, stakeholder satisfaction
* Team leadership: growth and performance of mentees/direct reports, delivery quality across the product area
* Customer outcomes: pilot-to-scale conversion, referenceable wins in procurement engagements

**Reporting Relationships**
Reports to a Senior Manager / AVP of Product Management. Works as one team with engineering, data science, and design; partners with US-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders; collaborates with GTM, account, risk/compliance, and Deloitte Consulting Delivery and Practice teams across India. May mentor or informally guide Consultants and Analysts on the team.
  
  
**Working Model & Stakeholders**
Remote + hybrid model (typically 2–3 days onsite), with flexibility based on team and client needs, operating in agile product teams on a regular release cadence.
  
  
Core stakeholders: Engineering (platform + product squads), Data Science/Applied AI, Design/Research, Cybersecurity & Privacy, Risk/Legal/Compliance, Domain SMEs (procurement, sourcing, supply chain, finance), Sales/Alliances/Delivery, and client-side procurement leaders, category managers, process owners, IT, and operations.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required**

* 8–12 years in product management or product ownership, including owning a product area end-to-end with measurable business outcomes
* Track record of shipping products or major features from discovery to launch, and leading through ambiguity across multiple concurrent workstreams
* Strong hands-on product craft: backlog, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and day-to-day partnership with engineering and design in an agile setup
* Fluent in discovery and validation — user research, hypothesis testing, experimentation — not just delivery
* Experience delivering products involving AI/ML (GenAI preferred), including evaluation, monitoring, and iteration loops
* Exposure to procurement, sourcing, or supply chain — either as a product focus or through direct stakeholder work — with demonstrated ability to build domain depth quickly
* Comfortable client-facing, including product demos and discovery with senior stakeholders
* Experience mentoring or informally leading other product managers, owners, or analysts
* Working knowledge of enterprise integration patterns (APIs, identity/SSO, RBAC, data pipelines)
* Based in India, able to work virtually with US stakeholders on US-market direction and nuances

**Preferred**

* Domain depth in procurement/sourcing (direct/indirect sourcing, RFx, spend analytics, supplier management, purchase-to-pay)
* Experience with agentic architectures (tool calling, RAG, workflow orchestration, multi-agent patterns)

* Problem-obsessed and customer-centric

* Clear communicator across engineering, design, risk, and senior stakeholders
* Data-driven, with sound judgment under ambiguity
* Develops others — mentors and raises the craft of the team around them

Great products are built by people who stay close to the user and close to the craft — and great product organizations are built by people who can also lead others to do the same. This role owns a strategically important slice of the procurement portfolio in Zora AI, from vision through delivery through governance, while growing the next generation of product talent in USI. description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Customer**
The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Level: Manager or equivalent
  
  
We are seeking a Sales Operations Technologist Manager to lead the design and implementation of scalable Sales Operations solutions across CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, analytics, and AI platforms. This role combines deep Sales Operations domain expertise with solution architecture, systems integration, automation, delivery leadership, and practical application of Agentic AI.
  
  
The successful candidate will help life sciences organizations improve commercial effectiveness across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, diagnostics, and healthcare businesses. The Manager will lead client engagements, shape solution strategies, develop high-performing teams, and contribute to the growth of our Sales Operations and commercial technology capabilities.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
As a Manager, you will lead multidisciplinary teams and work directly with client executives, commercial leaders, business stakeholders, IT organizations, data teams, and technology partners to deliver measurable business outcomes. You will be responsible for shaping solutions from strategy and discovery through design, implementation, adoption, and value realization.
  
  
You will lead and oversee work across the following areas:
  
  

* Translate Sales Operations requirements into scalable solutions supporting territory and account alignment, segmentation and targeting, quota and incentive planning, sales forecasting, pipeline and opportunity management, account planning, field productivity, pricing and quoting, approvals, and commercial performance reporting.
* Define enterprise solution architectures and delivery approaches integrating CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, analytics, workflow, and AI platforms.
* Lead implementations and solution delivery across platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, SAP, and other enterprise applications.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, APIs, data models, workflows, accelerators, and delivery standards that can be deployed across client environments.
* Identify, prioritize, and oversee practical Agentic AI use cases, including sales planning assistants, forecasting and pipeline analysis agents, next-best-action recommendations, account and territory intelligence, automated opportunity and CRM hygiene, quoting and approval support, and sales performance insights.
* Define and oversee human-in-the-loop controls, access controls, auditability, evaluation criteria, monitoring, and escalation paths for AI-enabled solutions.
* Lead discovery workshops, process assessments, design sessions, demonstrations, executive discussions, testing, deployment planning, and adoption activities.
* Build trusted relationships with client executives and key stakeholders, facilitate difficult decisions, manage expectations, and communicate risks, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly.
* Manage delivery quality, scope, schedule, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and financial performance across workstreams or engagements.
* Coach and develop consultants and senior consultants through structured feedback, hands-on leadership, and opportunities to expand their domain and technology expertise.
* Establish solution roadmaps, implementation plans, operating models, adoption strategies, governance approaches, and measurable value cases.
* Support and lead pre-sales activities, including account planning, proposals, statements of work, solution demonstrations, estimates, client presentations, and pursuit strategy.
* Contribute to market eminence, intellectual capital, reusable assets, accelerators, and offerings that strengthen our Sales Operations and commercial technology portfolio.
* Ensure solutions reflect life sciences-specific requirements related to HCP/HCO data, field force structures, regulatory expectations, data privacy, commercial compliance, and data governance.

**The team:**
Step into our
**Sales & Service**
team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. As a global, dynamic group, we deliver seamless, end-to-end solutions—advising on strategy, implementing advanced CRM or back-office platforms, and enabling continuous business improvement. Here, you’ll collaborate with passionate, creative minds to transform sales models, elevate service excellence, and optimize customer operations. If you’re ready to grow your expertise, make bold ideas real, and help redefine the customer experience for leading organizations, this is your next big move. Join us and shape the future of sales and service!
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 8+ years of consulting or industry experience, including significant experience leading Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, CRM, CPQ, business transformation, or technology implementation initiatives.
* Experience leading end-to-end client engagements or major workstreams, including delivery planning, team leadership, quality management, risk management, and executive communication.
* Strong understanding of Sales Operations processes and performance drivers, including territory and account alignment, segmentation, targeting, quota and incentive planning, forecasting, pipeline management, account planning, pricing, quoting, approvals, and performance reporting.
* Experience implementing or integrating two or more CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, or analytics platforms.
* Experience with APIs, middleware, data integration, workflow automation, enterprise solution architecture, and delivery governance.
* Practical knowledge of Agentic AI, generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, AI orchestration, or related enterprise AI patterns.
* Ability to convert business requirements into solution strategies, functional designs, technical specifications, implementation plans, roadmaps, and value cases.
* Demonstrated ability to lead workshops, influence senior stakeholders, manage ambiguity, resolve issues, and make sound delivery decisions.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience leading, coaching, and developing consulting or technology delivery teams

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Experience with Salesforce, Veeva CRM, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle CPQ, Salesforce Revenue Cloud, SAP CPQ, or similar platforms.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, diagnostics, or healthcare commercial operations.
* Knowledge of HCP/HCO master data, customer consent, field force effectiveness, promotional compliance, and commercial data governance.
* Experience with cloud platforms, data warehouses, business intelligence tools, and low-code/no-code automation platforms.
* Familiarity with AI governance, model evaluation, prompt engineering, agent monitoring, responsible AI practices, and enterprise controls.
* Consulting, systems integration, product management, enterprise architecture, or operating model design experience.
* Experience developing proposals, estimates, solution demonstrations, reusable assets, or market-facing points of view.
* Relevant Salesforce, Veeva, CPQ, cloud, data, architecture, or AI certifications.

**Success Measures**
Success in this role will be measured by:
  
  

* Delivery of high-quality Sales Operations solutions that achieve agreed client outcomes, timelines, and quality expectations.
* Adoption, usability, and sustained business value of implemented solutions.
* Reduction in manual processes, disconnected workflows, and operational friction.
* Improved CRM, Sales Operations, and commercial data quality.
* Faster planning, forecasting, quoting, approval, and decision-making cycles.
* Reusability and scalability of solution components across platforms, business units, and clients.
* Demonstrated business value from AI-enabled capabilities with appropriate controls and monitoring.
* Effective management of data privacy, compliance, security, delivery, and operational risks.
* Strong client relationships, team engagement, talent development, and contribution to pursuit and practice growth.

**Education:**

You will champion operational excellence through proactive monitoring, incident response, and identifying opportunities for automation and process improvement.

title: Programme Manager - Enterprise AI

**For more information, visit WPP.com.**
**Why we're hiring:**
 WPP is accelerating the adoption of AI across the enterprise, investing in a portfolio of strategic initiatives designed to transform how work gets done across our global business.
   

  

 Within Enterprise Technology, we're enabling this transformation by building the platforms, capabilities and operating models that will power the next generation of work. From Microsoft Copilot and intelligent automation to emerging AI technologies and agentic workflows, we're embedding AI into the fabric of how WPP operates globally.
   

  

 We're looking for a Programme Manager (Value \& Delivery) to help us understand, measure and evidence the impact of AI across the organisation.
   

  

 This role sits at the centre of WPP's Enterprise AI adoption and measurement capability. You'll own the data, reporting and analytics that enable senior leaders to understand how AI is being adopted, where value is being created and what actions are needed to accelerate impact.
   

  

 We're looking for someone who combines strong analytical and data modelling expertise with a delivery mindset. You'll be responsible for building trusted executive reporting, integrating data from multiple sources and ensuring adoption, usage and value metrics stand up to scrutiny. If you enjoy turning complex datasets into actionable insight and want to play a key role in one of WPP's most important transformation programmes, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Manage the recurring cadence of adoption, utilisation and value reporting, ensuring weekly and monthly reporting cycles are delivered accurately and on schedule.
* Track licence utilisation and adoption across the Enterprise AI estate, helping identify optimisation opportunities and supporting investment decisions.
* Maintain benefits and ROI tracking against agreed business cases, ensuring evidence, assumptions and outcomes are clearly documented.
* Coordinate activity across the Enterprise AI opportunity pipeline, tracking progress, dependencies, actions and risks to ensure initiatives keep moving forward.
* Support use\-case intake and assessment processes, helping prioritise opportunities and ensuring requests are routed effectively through governance and delivery pathways.
* Oversee the configuration and maintenance of adoption and measurement reporting, including Viva Insights and related analytics platforms.
* Maintain programme governance artefacts, including RAID logs, action trackers, status reports and delivery plans.
* Prepare clear, concise reporting and updates for stakeholders, providing visibility of progress, risks, issues and outcomes.
* Work closely with programme, delivery, governance and business teams to ensure activities remain aligned and focused on measurable value.
* Help identify process improvements and opportunities to strengthen the efficiency and effectiveness of the Enterprise AI operating model.


**What We're Looking For**
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft 365 adoption programmes or digital transformation initiatives.
* Working familiarity with Viva Insights, Power BI and workforce analytics platforms.
* Experience in programme management, programme delivery, business analysis or benefits tracking within a complex organisational environment.
* Proven ability to coordinate multiple activities and stakeholders while maintaining strong attention to detail and delivery discipline.
* Comfort working with data, metrics and reporting, with the ability to validate, explain and challenge information rather than simply present it.
* Strong organisational skills, with experience maintaining reporting cycles, governance artefacts and programme documentation.
* Analytical curiosity and a desire to understand the drivers behind performance, adoption and business outcomes.
* Experience working with reporting and analysis tools such as Excel, Power BI or similar platforms.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to tailor information for both operational and senior stakeholder audiences.
* A proactive, self\-directed approach with the confidence to drive actions, follow through on deliverables and keep programmes moving.
* Strong written communication skills and the ability to produce clear, professional status reporting and programme updates.


**Nice to have**
* Knowledge of benefits tracking, value realisation or programme performance measurement.
* Microsoft AZ\-900, DP\-900, PMP, PRINCE2 or similar qualifications.
* Experience working within a global organisation and coordinating distributed teams across multiple regions.


**Who you are:**
**You're open
 *:***
 we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open\-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.
   

  

**You're optimistic
 *:***
 we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.
   

  

**You're extraordinary:** 
 We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.
   

  

**What we'll give you:**
**Passionate, inspired people** 
 – we champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work

title: IT Strategist
description:
**Job Title:** 
 IT Strategist
   

  

**Department** 
 : ISPL Cardif IT
   

  

**About Business Line/Function**
 BNP Paribas Cardif is a world leader in bancassurance partnerships, providing its customers with products and services that let them realise their goals while protecting themselves from unforeseen events. BNP Paribas Cardif is committed to having a positive impact on society and to making insurance more accessible. A subsidiary of BNP Paribas, the insurer has a unique business model anchored in partnerships. It creates solutions for more than 500 partner distributors in a variety of sectors – including banks and financial institutions, automotive sector companies, retailers and telecommunications companies – as well as for financial advisors and brokers who market the products to their customers. With a presence in 30 countries and strong positions in Europe, Asia and Latin America, BNP Paribas Cardif is a global specialist in personal insurance, the world leader in creditor insurance and a major contributor to financing for the real economy. With 9,000 employees worldwide, BNP Paribas Cardif had gross written premiums of €40\.5 billion in 2025\.
   

  

 BNP Paribas Cardif IT is a global organization with about 3000 IT staff across Europe, Latin America and Asia. Its mission is to drive and support our business strategy across all regions by leading digital transformation and delivering secure, resilient, and scalable industrial technology solutions. It is committed to enabling innovation, strengthening cyber resilience, and fostering collaboration and diversity across markets and teams to create exceptional value for our customers and partners, and ensure sustainable growth for BNP Paribas Cardif at the global scale.
   

  

**Position Purpose:** 
 The
 **IT Strategist** 
 is the strategic architect and operational orchestrator for the IT leadership team. This role is responsible for defining the department's strategic direction and ensuring its successful execution through rigorous governance, transformation management, and high\-level communication. You will act as the bridge between strategic intent (CTO/CIO vision) and operational reality (Production/Delivery), ensuring that the organization’s transformation—specifically the India sourcing initiative—is seamless, data\-driven, and delivers maximum value to our business beneficiaries.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

* Strategic Definition \& Roadmap Orchestration
* Strategy Formulation: Actively contribute to the definition and promotion of the IT industrialization and production strategy, ensuring alignment with the BNP Paribas Group’s global technological policy.
* Transformation Roadmap: Design and manage the multi\-year transformation roadmap, translating long\-term vision into actionable milestones for the India transition and other strategic shifts.
* Decision Support: Provide the COO/Head of IT with high\-level synthesis, risk opinions, and "decision\-ready" intelligence to facilitate complex strategic choices.
* Executive Communication \& Visual Storytelling
* Strategic Narrative Design: Lead the creation of sophisticated, executive\-level presentations (PowerPoint) for Steering Committees, Board reviews, and Group\-level reporting.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Develop and execute communication plans that translate technical and operational complexities into clear, compelling business value for Onshore Beneficiaries and Group leadership.
* Transparency \& Reporting: Establish a culture of transparency by designing high\-level reporting frameworks that provide a consolidated view of strategy, budget, and transformation progress.
* Governance, Performance \& Business Alignment
* Governance Frameworks: Implement and lead governance bodies to facilitate decision\-making processes, trajectory monitoring, and stakeholder alignment.
* KPI \& Performance Architecture: Define and oversee the deployment of relevant performance indicators (KPIs/SLOs) to monitor the quality, stability, and ROI of the new operational setup.
* Business Relationship Liaison: Act as the ultimate escalation point for "business irritants," ensuring that the interests of Onshore Beneficiaries are represented in the design and implementation of new IT solutions.
* Operational \& Financial Oversight
* Transformation Monitoring: Oversee the "Build, Run, Improve" cycle of the transformation, ensuring that the transition to India delivers expected efficiency and cost\-control targets.
* Budget \& Cost Governance: Monitor the departmental strategic budget, ensuring that investments in transformation and production are based on a clear business rationale (ROI/Efficiency).
* Risk \& Continuity Oversight: Ensure that the transformation strategy integrates IT Risk, Cybersecurity, and Business Continuity (BCP) requirements from the design phase.


**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**
* Strategy \& Transformation: Proven ability to define, promote, and implement large\-scale organizational change and IT industrialization strategies.
* Business / IT Relationship Management: Expertise in managing complex stakeholder ecosystems and aligning IT capabilities with business needs.
* Financial \& Budget Steering: Ability to manage strategic budgets, monitor cost evolution, and ensure the financial viability of the transformation roadmap.
* Risk \& Governance: Deep understanding of IT Risk, Cybersecurity governance, and the ability to provide informed "Risk Opinions" on strategic decisions.


**Specific Qualifications**
**Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**
**Technical Skills**
* Advanced Visual Storytelling: Mastery of PowerPoint to create high\-impact, executive\-level visual narratives.
* Analytical Ability: Superior ability to synthesize vast amounts of data into actionable strategic insights.
* Project/Program Management: Advanced knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, and ITIL methodologies to oversee complex, multi\-threaded programs.
* Change Management: Ability to understand, explain, and support large\-scale organizational change.


**Behavioral Skills**
* Impact \& Influence: Exceptional ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive commitment toward a shared strategic vision.
* Decision Making: Ability to make high\-pressure decisions based on incomplete or complex information.
* Resilience: High capacity to maintain focus and leadership stability in a fast\-paced, transformative, and often ambiguous environment.
* Creativity \& Problem Solving: A proactive approach to identifying bottlenecks in the transformation and designing innovative solutions.
* Communication Excellence: Mastery of both oral and written communication in English, tailored for executive audiences.


**Education Level:** 
 Master’s Degree
   

  

**Experience:** 
 10–15\+ years
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai
   

  

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.

 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Who We Are**
 Arcadia is the AI\-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
   

  

 Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI\-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
 ****cut carbon****
 .
   

  

**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**
* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI\-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all. .
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.


 Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
   

  

****Senior Product Manager, Platform****
**What We're Looking For**
 We're seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to join the Presentment value stream within Arcadia's Utility Data Platform (UDP) pillar. Presentment owns the customer\-facing layer of the utility data pipeline, Plug, UDS, DELI, and DICE, that lets customers and downstream systems manage, retrieve, and consume utility data. This person will help define and drive product requirements for Plug's presentment capabilities — the APIs, delivery workflows, and customer\-facing tools that make Arcadia's unified data model usable at scale — partnering closely with the Presentment product lead, who sets overall roadmap direction.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between an API spec, a front\-end wireframe review, and a cloud architecture discussion, and can turn distinct customer and downstream\-team needs into a coherent, well\-documented presentment layer. This person should be comfortable using AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to boost their own and their team's productivity.
 ****Note: this is not an AI\-native product role****
 — the mandate is data presentment and delivery, not building AI/ML product features.
   

  

 The Presentment engineering team consists of 10\+ engineers and 2 engineering managers, split across the US and India. This person will collaborate frequently with engineering (India and US), other Presentment and UDP product leads, and cross\-functional teams like Customer Success and Operations to ensure the success of their product. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter, detail\-oriented, and a systems thinker who enjoys breaking complex problems into smaller steps that drive iterative delivery, and who can build and execute roadmaps while coordinating cross\-team dependencies to completion.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Drive execution of the Plug presentment roadmap — the customer\-facing APIs and interfaces that deliver utility data to internal and external consumers.
* Define, prioritize, and ship features that scale Plug across new and existing customer use cases.
* Partner with engineering to evolve the data delivery architecture, including cloud infrastructure (AWS) decisions that affect scale, reliability, and cost.
* Define and maintain clear, well\-documented API contracts and specifications for downstream teams and external partners consuming Plug data.
* Collaborate with front\-end engineering and design on customer\-facing tools (delivery configuration, status/breadcrumb visibility, self\-serve workflows).
* Partner with upstream Extraction, Auditing \& Storage (EAS) teams to ensure presentment changes stay aligned with the canonical unified data model.
* Write clear product requirements and specs that are easily understood by both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Own day\-to\-day management of KTLO and balance run\-the\-business work and tech\-debt reduction against new capability delivery, including evaluating where AI can reduce run\-the\-business load (without shifting the role's core mandate to AI product work).
* Use AI tools to improve personal and team productivity, and model good AI\-assisted workflows for the squad.
* Monitor and communicate progress on initiatives to stakeholders and the leadership team.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with peers in Engineering, Operations, and other UDP value streams (Acquisition, EAS) to deliver on time.
* Contribute to public\-facing API documentation (docs.arcadia.com) so external partners and customers can self\-serve integration with Plug.


**What Will Help You Succeed**
****Must\-Haves****
* 6\+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time on cloud\-based SaaS or data platform products.
* Solid data management fundamentals: familiarity with data models, storage systems (e.g., Snowflake), and how data moves through acquisition, storage, and delivery layers.
* Experience partnering with front\-end engineering and design on customer\-facing product surfaces (dashboards, configuration tools, self\-serve workflows).
* Proven experience defining and documenting APIs, contracts, versioning, and developer\-facing documentation, for consumption by multiple downstream teams or external partners.
* Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) and how architecture choices affect product scale, reliability, and cost.
* Comfortable using AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to increase personal and team productivity.
* Comfort with ambiguity and iterative delivery in a fast\-changing environment.
* Experience working with globally distributed engineering teams across time zones (India/US).
* Demonstrated experience aligning and influencing cross\-functional teams and diverse stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to translate technical tradeoffs for both engineering and business audiences.


****Nice\-to\-Haves****
* Experience in energy, utilities, or fintech/expense\-management software.
* Experience with legacy\-to\-modern platform migrations or system consolidation (relevant to the ongoing UDS → Plug migration).
* Experience with developer\-facing APIs/SDKs or API\-first product strategy.
* Experience with data governance, master data management, or data cataloging tools.
* Background in a regulated vertical (energy, finance, telecom, healthcare).


**Benefits**
****Compensation \& Benefits****
* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits
* 
+ Flexible Leave Policy
+ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

* We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
* Medical Insurance (1\+5 Family Members)
* Flexible Benefit Plan
* Awards and Bonus
* Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency


 Eliminating carbon footprints, eliminating carbon copies.
   

  

 Here at Arcadia, we cultivate diversity, celebrate individuality, and believe unique perspectives are key to our collective success in creating a clean energy future. Arcadia is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
