title: Product Manager
description:
Global Customs IT PDO team partners with internal Mfg. MPL Systems, Finance Systems, and Invoicing systems, and external customs solution/service providers to provide end\-to\-end customs solutions to manage customs operations globally, enabling Free Trade Agreement (FTA) qualifications and meeting legal and regulatory needs when importing and exporting parts and vehicles.
   

  

 Are you a hands\-on product manager with strong technical leader understanding for creating exceptional developer tools and infrastructure? Global Customs is looking for a Product Manager who embraces Lean, Agile and Human Centered Design practices to deliver innovative software products for Ford Motor Company. As our Developer Enablement Leader, you will be instrumental in shaping the future of our Customs IT practices. You'll lead the charge in evaluating, implementing, and driving the adoption of cutting\-edge technologies and best practices – from CI/CD pipelines and testing frameworks to monitoring solutions. Your work will directly empower our software engineers to build high\-quality software faster and more efficiently. You will also play a key role in enhancing our internal development platform, ensuring it provides a robust and scalable foundation for all our teams. If you possess deep expertise in DevOps principles, modernization through Google Cloud adoption, a relentless drive for automation, and a proven history of building and scaling developer infrastructure, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Fuel Developer Productivity:** 
 Your primary mission will be to empower our development teams to be as productive and efficient as possible.
   

  

**This Means**
**Driving Product Strategy:** 
 Owning the product vision and roadmap to ensure Customs IT delivers maximum business value.
   

  

* Product Discovery: Engaging customers and business stakeholders to uncover needs, validate problems, and identify opportunities before committing engineering investment.
* Roadmap Prioritization: Defining and prioritizing the product roadmap based on customer impact, strategic alignment, and delivery feasibility.
* Stakeholder Prioritization: Balancing and negotiating competing requests across NA, EU, and IMG stakeholders to focus the team on the highest\-value work.
* Backlog Grooming: Owning and continuously refining the product backlog, writing clear epics/stories, and ensuring readiness for sprint planning.
* Business Value Articulation: Building the business case for initiatives and clearly communicating expected ROI, cost savings, and developer productivity gains to leadership.


**Orchestrating Innovation:** 
 Conduct experimentation and build products that would accelerate developer flow.
   

  

**Cloud\-Native Empowerment:** 
 Playing a vital role in enabling developers to build and deploy applications seamlessly on our chosen cloud platform (GCP, OpenShift, GKE), making the cloud a natural extension of their development workflow.
   

  

**Inner Source Evangelist:** 
 Collaborating with teams to cultivate a culture of knowledge sharing and innovation by encouraging developers to contribute to internal customs projects and collaborate across team boundaries – NA, EU, and IMG.
   

  

**Promote New Products with AI:** 
 Conduct experimentation and build products that would accelerate developer flow. Design, develop, and deploy AI\-powered solutions for code acceleration and tech debt reduction, leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG).
   

  

**DevSecOps Champion:** 
 Driving the adoption of DevSecOps principles and practices, embedding security into every stage of the development lifecycle.
   

  

**Lead and Inspire:** 
 You'll be a great leader, mentor, and advocate for our development teams. This means:
   

  

**Providing Expert Guidance:** 
 Sharing your deep knowledge on a variety of topics related to developer tooling, best practices, and emerging technologies.
   

  

**Lead the Code Reviews:** 
 Leading \& Providing constructive feedback on code quality, architectural alignment, and adherence to best practices.
   

  

**Staying Ahead of the Curve:** 
 Keeping your finger on the pulse of the latest industry trends and emerging technologies in the developer tooling space.
   

  

**Championing Continuous Improvement:** 
 Continuously seeking ways to improve our platform, processes, and the overall developer experience.
   

  

**Collaborate and Communicate:** 
 You'll be a critical bridge between development teams and other stakeholders, ensuring everyone is aligned and working towards a common vision. This means:
   

  

**Working Closely with Teams:** 
 Collaborating with development teams, architects, product managers, security teams, and the "Tools" team.
   

  

**Communicating Effectively:** 
 Explaining complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
   

  

**Presenting at Events:** 
 Sharing your knowledge and insights at team meetings, workshops, and conferences, inspiring others to embrace new technologies and best practices.
   

  

**Acting as a Liaison:** 
 Representing the needs of development teams to other departments, ensuring their voices are heard.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
* A bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in project management \& software development \- with a focus on Java, Angular, and Spring Boot.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience with Agile methodologies, including defining product vision and strategy, building product roadmaps, and creating and managing backlogs.
* A deep understanding of object\-oriented design principles and patterns.
* A proven track record of driving adoption of developer tools and best practices.
* A deep understanding in modern development tools (VS Code, IntelliJ with CoPilot assistance etc) and technologies (e.g., Git, Gradle, Tekton, Terraform, OpenShift / Kubernetes, SonarQube, Checkmarx, Cycode/ SAST \& FOSSA etc).
* Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., GCP – Preferred, Azure/AWS – Nice to have).
* Familiarity with agile development methodologies.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Mainframe – nice to have.
* COBOL – nice to have.
* Familiarity with customs regulations, trade compliance processes, or Free Trade Agreement (FTA) requirements – nice to have.


**Additional Skills**
* Experience with developer enablement initiatives.
* Experience with DevSecOps practices.
* Experience with API design and development.
* Experience with microservices architecture.
* Experience mentoring and coaching junior developers.
* Knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG).


**Key Skills**
* End\-to\-End Program / Project Management experience
* Java, Angular, Spring Boot is mandatory; good to have experience in GCP implementations.
* Developer Enablement
* CI/CD
* Cloud Technologies – GCP preferably
* Agile Development
* Communication
* Problem\-Solving
* Software Architecture Patterns
* Understanding on Test\-Driven Development (TDD)
* Understanding on Java Full Stack \& GCP offerings
* Understanding on Databases (e.g., PostgreSQL – Preferred; SQL Server, Oracle – Nice to have)

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**About Chargebee** 




 Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth.
 



 Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Condé Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2\.
 



 With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U.S., and Europe.
 



  





**About the Team** 




 Chargebee's Platform Product \& Engineering teams are responsible for ensuring our technical platform and infrastructure meets the expectations of businesses who rely on Chargebee to run their most important revenue operations. These businesses depend on our technical platform to be robust, extensible, performant, reliable, stable, secure and scalable in order to process billions of dollars (and Euros, and other currencies) worth of transactions with enterprise\-class service levels. Our Platform Product Managers make sure we consistently meet and exceed what merchants expect of our technical platform, working closely with engineering and technical and non\-technical operations teams to do so.
 



  





**About the role (Job Summary)** 




 As a member of the platform product team, you will support our ongoing strategic focus on modernizing our platform — a series of initiatives in which we are investing significant resources. We're building a microservice architecture that powers a series of loosely\-coupled capabilities used across Chargebee's product lines. Our modernized platform will support throughputs an order of magnitude higher than our legacy platform, with lower latency and higher service levels and will be built to enable rapid development cycles with built\-in trust and integrity controls. The modernized platform runs on a standardized and abstract cloud fabric. In addition to runtime transactional components, the modernized platform will also include enterprise data management (including data science and machine learning applications), observability and analytical, and developer productivity components.
 



  





**What you'll do (role and responsibilities)** 




 Drive planning and prioritization for your feature area within a platform domain, define and track key metrics, and work closely with engineers to define feature functionality and execute against the roadmap.
 



 • You'll focus on one or more of the following domains: APIs (endpoints \& contracts, workflows, orchestration, frameworks and infrastructure); core platform services (including IAM, queue and job management, auditing, search, notifications, etc.) and service frameworks; transactional data management, enterprise data, DS/ML, and analytical systems; cloud fabric (containers, compute, storage, etc.); path\-to\-production (build, quality, release gates, automated testing and validation, deployment); observability, telemetry, proactive platform health management and incident processes; and platform initiatives (security, privacy/data protection; technical standards and governance and SLAs/SLOs).
 



 • Engage with internal partner teams (and external customers, where relevant) to gather product requirements and feedback through discussions, presentations, and preview programs, and translate that input into clear, detailed requirements.
 



 • Own the product lifecycle for your assigned features and services end to end — from discovery through requirements, build, launch, and iteration — shipping consistently against an established roadmap.
 



 • As you build fluency in your domain, increasingly help shape near\-term roadmap decisions for your feature area in partnership with Staff and Principal PMs, making sure your recommendations align with the broader platform strategy they've set.
 



 • Manage the product lifecycle for your feature area, working with cross\-functional partners (technical and non\-technical) to solve concrete problems faced by Chargebee, our developers, merchants, and our merchants' end users.
 



 • Communicate progress, trade\-offs, and value delivered clearly to your immediate stakeholders and cross\-functional partners.
 



 • Conduct technical product discovery at the feature level: understand customer needs (internal and external) and technical constraints well enough to write sound requirements and make day\-to\-day prioritization calls.
 



 • Create detailed product requirements and acceptance criteria (within Agile Kanban or Scrum processes); manage your portion of the roadmap; prioritize within your assigned feature area.
 



 • Working with an analytics partner, track the input and output metrics (technical and business) relevant to your feature area and report on progress.
 



 • Working with a program management partner, follow operational processes and support staged, incremental roll\-out plans.
 



 • Help uphold SLAs and SLOs relevant to your feature area.
 



 • Operate with growing autonomy within a matrix environment; escalate and help resolve blockers, and build strong working relationships across engineering, program management, and operations.
 



  





**What you'll bring (required skills and experience)** 




 • Domain\-appropriate knowledge: e.g., APIs (REST, GraphQL, etc.); streaming, OLTP and OLAP data systems; service frameworks; CI/CD, etc. (You are not expected to have full domain depth on day one; you should be a fast learner.)
 



 • Foundational systems thinking: ability to understand how the parts of a technical system fit together at the feature/service level, with growing ability to reason at a broader system level.
 



 • Background in platform product management with 5\-8\+ years of practical experience.
 



 • Strong written and oral communication skills; ability to listen and understand what drives people.
 



 • Experience working in a remote, distributed, global (cross\-time\-zone) company in a rapidly changing business environment, or a strong willingness and ability to adapt to one.
 



 • Ability to work with ambiguity and in gray spaces, with support from more senior PMs.
 



 • Solid critical thinking, problem\-solving, and analytical skills.
 



 • Experience with ecommerce, SaaS, or related software applications running on the internet; exposure to complex/distributed systems and cloud technologies (e.g., AWS, Kubernetes, etc.) is a plus.
 



 • Experience or demonstrated ability collaborating with cross\-functional teams outside your reporting line.
 



 • Past experience as a software developer or SDET, or equivalent technical exposure, is a plus.
 



 • Higher education in a technical field (CS, EE, Information Systems) or equivalent experience.
 



  





**Benefits we offer** 




 At Chargebee, we believe that feeling supported is the foundation for doing great work. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your personal, financial, and professional growth and ensure you thrive in every aspect of your life. Our commitment to supporting our employees is universal, while our benefits are thoughtfully designed to meet the unique needs of each region. We offer comprehensive packages that generally include:
 


* Health \& Wellness: Robust coverage and access to programs to support your physical and mental well\-being.
* Financial Security: Initiatives to help you build long\-term financial stability.
* Work\-Life Balance: Flexible options and resources to help you thrive both professionally and personally.



  





*Chargebee is an equal opportunity employer. At Chargebee, we believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences is not a "good\-to\-have" but a "must\-have" as it strengthens us as a company and as individuals. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive.* 




*We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, age, national origin, ancestry, caste, citizenship, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

description:
**Shape Enterprise Construction Data Architecture as a Product Manager – Common Data Environment (CDE)**
 Are you a systems\-and\-customer thinker who excels at turning complex data integration layers into seamless, intuitive user experiences? Trimble is seeking a technically fluent Senior Product Manager to own how enterprise customers bring their data into
 **Trimble Connect** 
 —and how they experience, structure, and govern that data once it arrives. As construction data multiplies across global tools and project teams, you will play a central role in driving the platform that connects the right people to the right data at the right time.
   

  

**About Us**
 Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is an industrial technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. In support of Trimble's Connect and Scale strategy and the Trimble Connected Construction vision, Trimble Connect serves as the open collaboration backbone for millions of users worldwide. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com
   

  

**Our Product Ecosystem:** 
 Trimble Connect is our central Common Data Environment (CDE) and cloud collaboration platform. It breaks down data silos across the entire Architecture, Engineering, Construction, and Operations (AECO) lifecycle, enabling informed decision\-making and open project collaboration.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Great**
 In this high\-impact position, you will own Connect's data\-experience and CDE data domain end\-to\-end. You will partner directly with senior engineering leaders who build deep technical layers, weighing architectural trade\-offs where product strategy and platform architecture intersect. You will have full ownership over building application\-layer AI capabilities—such as AI\-assisted metadata, automated classification, and smart import mapping—while acting as an industry thought leader representing Trimble across globally distributed customer networks.
   

  

 Key Exciting Responsibilities
   

  

* Product Definition \& Strategic Roadmap: Transform a fragmented set of data capabilities and integrations into a coherent, highly differentiated product narrative tied directly to Trimble Connect's global growth strategy.
* AI\-Forward Data Experience: Design and deploy modern application\-layer AI features within the data experience, including AI\-assisted metadata generation, automated file classification, and smart import mapping.
* Technical \& Architectural Leadership: Partner closely with senior engineering leaders on platform requirements, leveraging deep technical fluency to weigh architecture trade\-offs across data models, authorization frameworks, and APIs.
* Customer Engagement \& Market Insights: Conduct direct strategic discovery with key users and C\-level customer executives to uncover actionable operational insights and validate platform capabilities.
* Product Evangelism \& Thought Leadership: Represent Trimble Connect as an industry thought leader at major forums, elevating our market credibility across the global construction ecosystem.
* Cross\-Functional Influence: Lead and align cross\-functional, globally distributed teams, translating complex data analysis and business goals into clear, executable product milestones.


**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Product Management Track Record: 5\+ years of direct experience operating as a platform Product Manager with a referenceable history of delivering impactful B2B software products.
* Technical \& Architectural Fluency: High technical literacy with the ability to discuss complex system trade\-offs alongside senior engineers—including comfort with enterprise data models, APIs, SaaS mechanics, and tiered authorization protocols.
* Systems \& Customer Thinking: Exceptional ability to conceptualize complex software ecosystems and synthesize fragmented integrations into a unified, user\-friendly platform experience.
* Stakeholder Influence \& Communication: Outstanding communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills with a proven track record of influencing senior leadership and cross\-functional teams without direct authority.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline).


**Bonus Points For**
* Construction Tech Domain Expertise: Direct experience within construction technology or a closely adjacent enterprise B2B software domain.
* CDE \& AEC Product Knowledge: Deep familiarity with Common Data Environments (CDE), collaboration tools, or spatial/BIM data management products in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry.
* AI Integration: Hands\-on experience defining or launching AI/ML\-assisted features within enterprise SaaS platforms.


**Logistics**
* Department: AECO Platform
* Job Type: Full\-Time


 Why You'll Love Working With Us
   

  

 At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real\-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
   

  

* You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose\-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.
* Collaborate with like\-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.
* Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self\-authored," empowering proactive "doers."
* Enjoy true flexibility: We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us.


****How to Apply:****
 Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.
   

  

**Join a Values\-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.**
 At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.
   

  

 Candidate Privacy Notices by Country
   

  

 If you need assistance or would like to request an accommodation in connection with the application process, please contact careers@trimble.com.

title: Digital Product Manager
description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever\-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Digital Product Managers** 
 at U. S. Bank are customer obsessed in defining and delivering the strategy and vision required for digital experiences to stay ahead of constantly evolving economic, competitive, technological, and customer needs. As a Digital Product Manager, you will:
   

  

* Ensures a data\-driven approach to prioritize “building the right thing” that maximizes results for both end users and internal business partners.
* Relentlessly focused on ongoing measurement and optimization of digital experiences that support seamless self\-service and human\-assisted customer interactions.
* Advocates for reusability of capabilities to drive cost\-effective scale and speed to market.
* Leverage market and competitive insights, customer needs, and internal business priorities to establish a digital product vision.
* Vision includes definition of best\-in\-class, future\-state user experience journey and role of experience in delivering competitive differentiation.
* Align digital product vision across other enabling functions to establish an integrated delivery roadmap.
* Regularly re\-evaluates priorities during planning to optimize capacity against user and business value creation.
* Leverages OKRs (Objectives and Key Results) to drive roadmap priorities.
* Integrate digital products, platforms and capabilities to drive business value through an enhanced user experience.
* Advocates for the reusability and modernization of digital platforms and capabilities across the enterprise to improve speed to market, operational efficiency, risk / compliance adherence.
* Drives digital product development by actively managing the roadmap through the agile delivery lifecycle.
* Leverages Discovery to evaluate the best, most valuable ideas with customer centricity skillset.
* Enable the cross\-channel strategy (e.g., web, mobile, voice, in person etc.) by delivering integrated digital solutions that drive adoption, engagement and growth across both digital and human customer interactions.
* Identifies initial and ongoing digital product\-market fit through partnering with cross\-functional teams to deliver best\-in\-class research deliverables such as research briefs, personas, story maps, prototyping, product chartering, and mapping experiences.
* Develops north star metric (NSM) to connect business outcomes to customer value and unify the team and stakeholders against a singular goal.
* Continuously measures actual results against target NSM to manage performance and drive progress against product vision and strategy.
* Leverage NSM and leading indicators to optimize execution and ensure teams remain focused on highest value work.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Digital Product Management experience


**Preferred Skills/Experience**
 Work with product, design, and operations teams to deliver innovative ways to serve our learners.
   

  

* Supports what products to make, ensuring those products get made and reporting back on how users respond to products.
* Works with partners like engineering and design teams to strategically plan products and their development
* Works with external third parties to assess partnerships and licensing opportunities runs beta and pilot programs with early\-stage products and samples and becomes an expert with respect to the competition.
* Demonstrated ability as a technical product manager, product owner, or solutions architect.
* Proven experience as a software engineer, data engineer or SDET.


**Technical fluency –**
 Ability to understand, discuss, and challenge architectural concepts, trade offs, and new opportunities with technical team members. Understand technical issues well enough to make the right decisions about prioritizing not only new product features but also reducing technical debt or improving resiliency.
   

  

* Excellent written and verbal communication of ideas, narratives and complex technical information to a broad audience including, but not limited to: executives, stakeholders and engineers.


**Responsibilities** 
 :
   

  

* Work with engineering and key teams to deliver scalable and extensible software solutions to support business needs.
* Coordinate with business line product managers and other component teams to define your team's roadmap and delivery of product features.
* Translates business needs, user needs and technological capabilities into user stories and product specifications that will lead to successful implementations.
* Document detailed acceptance criteria that developers and QA can rely upon to complete their tasks.
* Drive Agile principles and methodologies, including owning the team backlogs, defining and prioritizing epics, features, user stories and other artifacts to support development goals.
* Define objective requirements with success criteria.

 This is an U.S. Bancorp India posting. U.S. Bancorp India is a part of the U.S. Bank family.

title: Product Manager
description:
Product Manager to drive the AI product portfolio through the full lifecycle — from prioritised plan to build, release, launch and adoption. Working alongside the Practice Head (Product Owner), who owns product features, requirements, industry benchmarking, the business case and go\-to\-market engagement, the Product Manager holds the product roadmap and prioritisation, translating the Practice Head's features and requirements into a sequenced, deliverable plan. The role engages clients directly — through demonstrations and requirement\-gathering, and into product support once each product is live in the client environment — drawing on Expleo's specialist Cyber Security, Cloud, Data, DevOps and Dev / QA practices throughout.
   

  

 Across delivery, the Product Manager ensures the Dev / QA team completes the solution design (high\- and low\-level design) ahead of build, coordinates the development, QA and DevOps teams through the build, and owns release and version governance across products and their underlying models. Security is embedded by design and owned end\-to\-end by the Cyber Security practice: the Product Manager gates security, compliance and responsible\-AI requirements into the definition of done and acts on each product's security assessment report before release
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Roadmap \& Prioritisation
* Own the AI portfolio roadmap and prioritisation, sequencing delivery and articulating trade\-offs and rationale transparently to stakeholders.
* Translate the product features and requirements owned by the Practice Head (Product Owner) into a prioritised, deliverable plan.
* Rationalise the existing roadmap toward the highest\-value outcomes across the portfolio.


**Delivery Coordination**
* Ensure the Dev / QA team completes the solution design (high\-level and low\-level design) ahead of build, with input from the Cloud, Data, Cyber Security and DevOps practices.
* Partner closely with the development, QA and DevOps teams and the Cyber Security, Cloud and Data practices throughout delivery, maintaining disciplined scope control against the agreed requirements.


**Security, Compliance \& Responsible AI**
* Ensure security, compliance and responsible\-AI requirements are captured, prioritised and gated as part of the definition of done — with all security owned by the Cyber Security practice, supported by the DevOps and Data practices.
* Obtain the security assessment report from the Cyber Security practice for each product, review the findings, and ensure they are prioritised and remediated before release.


**Release \& Version Governance**
* Establish a predictable release cadence and consistent versioning across the portfolio — covering both products and their underlying models — ensuring full traceability of what changed and when.


**Governance \& AI Management System (ISO/IEC 42001\)**
* Adhere to and enforce Expleo's ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System) process for each product, working with the process team to embed it across the product lifecycle.
* Ensure every product complies with the ISO/IEC 42001 standard and maintains its certification, in line with Expleo's governance requirements.
* Support the internal ISO/IEC 42001 audit conducted for each Expleo product — providing product evidence, coordinating audit responses, and driving identified findings to closure.
* Support external certification and surveillance audits with the artefacts and evidence required to achieve and maintain certification.


**Production Roll\-out \& Adoption**
* Support the production roll\-out of each AI product — coordinating deployment readiness, go\-live and post\-go\-live stabilisation with the delivery, operations and Cloud practice teams, aligned to the go\-to\-market plan led by the Practice Head.
* Own post\-launch adoption and revenue KPIs, monitoring performance and initiating corrective action where required.


**Client Engagement \& Product Support**
* Participate in client demonstrations and steering discussions, understanding client needs and relaying them to the Practice Head (Product Owner) for requirement definition.
* Liaise with the development, QA and DevOps teams and the Cyber Security, Cloud and Data practices to translate the agreed requirements into delivery.
* Once the product is delivered into the client environment, initiate and coordinate ongoing product support.


**Portfolio Health \& Lifecycle Decisions**
* Review product health on a quarterly basis and provide data\-driven invest, maintain or retire recommendations to the Practice Head, including managed product sunset where appropriate.


**Essential Qualifications \& Experience**
* A minimum of 12 years' experience in product management roles for B2B digital products, including at least one product taken through a full lifecycle stage transition.
* Demonstrable experience with cloud delivery models and direct commercial engagement, including participation in customer steering forums.
* Proven command of release management and versioning discipline, consistently delivering predictable, well\-governed product releases.
* A strong appreciation of security, compliance and responsible\-AI considerations as product requirements, with experience collaborating with cyber security, DevOps, cloud and data functions.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to drive decisions through well\-structured documentation.


**Desirable Qualifications**
* Hands\-on experience with GenAI, machine learning or agentic products.
* Familiarity with ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System) or comparable AI governance and certification frameworks.
* A track record of establishing product\-management discipline within a maturing team or function.
* A relevant professional certification (e.g., CSPO, SAFe POPM, PMP).


**KEY COMPETENCIES \& BEHAVIOURS**
* Strategic thinking balanced with hands\-on execution.
* Sound commercial judgement and effective prioritisation under ambiguity.
* Ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* A security\- and quality\-conscious mindset.
* Clear, concise, document\-led communication.

title: Platform Product Owner - Zendesk
description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
   

  

 Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
   

  

**The Team and Role:** 
 The Digital Office is a service\-centric organization where our cross\-functional teams are directly accountable for the business capabilities they enable. We own and manage large\-scale, business\-critical platforms supporting specific business functions and global customer experience operations.
   

  

 The
 **Zendesk Platform Product Owner** 
 (PPO) is a senior technical leadership position entrusted with the architectural integrity, innovation, and delivery of our enterprise customer support and experience ecosystem. Operating at the intersection of CX strategy and technical execution, the PPO ensures that the Zendesk platform architecture remains robust, scalable, secure, and fully aligned with both current and emerging organizational capabilities.
   

  

 As a key strategic partner, the PPO works closely with Business Capability Owners (BCOs) across Global Customer Care, Technical Support, and Operations to translate CX objectives into an actionable, forward\-looking Zendesk technology roadmap. The role demands hands\-on leadership, extensive domain expertise across the Zendesk Suite, custom app integrations, and significant proficiency in platform architecture, automation, and enterprise routing. Reporting to the Head of Platforms, the PPO leads, develops, and mentors the Platform Engineering and Administration team.
   

  

**Your Contribution:** 
 Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:
   

  

* Strategic Platform Ownership and Governance: Define and execute the Zendesk platform architecture and technical roadmap in alignment with BCO priorities. Drive platform governance by establishing standards for configuration management, custom code, API usage, data security, and release cycles.
* Technical Leadership and Hands\-on Execution: Act as the "Chief Practitioner" for Zendesk, applying deep hands\-on expertise across Zendesk Support, Guide, Talk, Messaging, Explore, and Sunshine. Lead the architecture of complex workflows, custom apps (ZAF framework), webhook integrations with ERP/CRM systems, and advanced ticket routing strategies.
* Team Leadership and Mentorship: Lead, mentor, and grow the Zendesk engineering and admin team. Define technical career paths, conduct code/configuration reviews, and unblock complex technical challenges to maintain high delivery velocity.
* Stakeholder Collaboration and Communication: Serve as the primary interface between CX leadership and engineering teams. Translate business needs into detailed technical user stories, while communicating platform roadmaps, risks, and performance metrics to non\-technical stakeholders.


**Key Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12\+ years of experience designing, configuring, and delivering enterprise customer service platform solutions.
* 5\+ years in a Product Owner, Platform Manager, or Enterprise Solution Architect role focused on Zendesk.
* Deep technical proficiency across the entire Zendesk ecosystem (Support, Guide, Explore, Messaging/Chat, Talk, Gather, and Sunshine platform).
* Strong hands\-on experience with Zendesk Apps Framework (ZAF), Zendesk REST APIs, Liquid markup, Webhooks, JSON, and custom Zendesk App development.
* Proven experience integrating Zendesk with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Oracle ERP, middleware (e.g., MuleSoft, Workato), and data warehouses.
* Practical expertise in configuring complex ticket routing, triggers, automations, SLAs, security controls, and custom objects/data models.
* Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum product management, backlog prioritization, and non\-functional requirements (scalability, GDPR/compliance, system performance).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for presenting technical strategies to senior leaders.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Zendesk Certified Expert / Master Administrator or Zendesk Certified App Developer.
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or equivalent Agile certification.
* Deep proficiency with project/portfolio management tools (e.g., Asana, Jira, Monday.com).
* Experience with AI/bot integrations (Zendesk AI, custom LLM integrations, or third\-party conversational AI platforms).

title: DPS - Associate PM

title: Product Owner - Intern
description:

 Smartail is an innovative Artificial Intelligence\-based company dedicated towards revolutionizing the education industry. By leveraging advanced technologies such as computer vision, deep learning, and natural language processing, DeepGrade excels in recognizing young adult handwriting and provides accurate grading for handwritten descriptive answers. It not only streamlines the grading process but also enhances learning, pedagogical decision\-making, assessment, and feedback for educational institutions. title: Technical Head
description:
About the Role
   


 Our client is seeking a self\-driven and motivated Technical Head to join their team. As a Technical Head, you will take ownership of creating products, tools, and techniques to help automate work processes, such as Robotic Process Automation (RPA). This role focuses on tactical\-level project\-to\-project service delivery, and you will not be required to handle strategic responsibilities.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Product and Tool Development: Build innovative products and tools to automate various aspects of the marketing and communication process, improving efficiency and quality.
* Process Understanding: Gain a deep understanding of the existing workflow and processes, identifying areas for improvement and automation.
* Deployment: Lead the deployment of newly developed products and tools, ensuring successful implementation within the organisation.
* Quality Improvement: Continuously improve the quality and reduce the time to deliver products and services.
* Customer Interaction: Interact with customers to gather requirements, understand their needs, and provide technical solutions.
* Team Building: Build and lead a team of professionals to support the technical initiatives and projects.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Proven experience in product and tool development, with a strong emphasis on automation.
* Hands\-on development experience is a must.
* Previous experience in customer\-facing roles.
* Middle to senior\-level professional.
* Self\-driven and motivated individual who can stick to commitments.
* Graduate / Post Graduate in IT preferred



  





 The successful candidate should have strong:
 


* Written and verbal communication skills
* Customer interaction and requirement\-gathering skills
* Technical solution presentation skills
* Stakeholder management capabilities
* Team leadership and interpersonal skills



  




 Reporting Structure
   


 The Technical Head will
 **report directly to the Chairman \& CEO** 
 .
 



 The role will initially focus on tactical, project\-to\-project technical delivery rather than organisation\-wide strategic technology responsibilities.
 



  




 Why Join?
 
  





 This is an opportunity to take ownership of technology initiatives in a growing organisation and directly contribute to improving business efficiency through
 **software development, automation and innovative technology solutions**

title: Catalog Manager
description:
**Job Summary** 




 The Catalogue Executive is responsible for managing the organization's product catalogue across all categories, ensuring every product is accurately represented in catalogues, quotation tools, and internal systems. The role focuses on catalogue accuracy, product data management, new product launches, SKU management, pricing updates, and supporting seamless collaboration between Category, Procurement, Design, Sales, Operations, and Technology teams. The objective is to maintain ascalable, standardized, and error\-free catalogue that enables excellent customer experience and
 



 efficient business operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Catalogue Management:** 



* Manage and maintain the master product catalogue, ensuring all product information is accurate, standardized, and up to date across all cities and platforms.
* Create, modify, and archive product records, ensuring discontinued products are removed and new products are added as per approved timelines.
* Maintain a consistent category hierarchy, product groupings, and catalogue version control.



  





**2\. Product Data Management:** 



* Ensure complete and accurate product information, including specifications, dimensions, finishes, materials, warranties, images, and descriptions.
* Validate product data received from vendors and internal stakeholders before publishing it in the catalogue
* Maintain data consistency across catalogues, quotation tools, and other business systems.



  





**3\. Pricing Management:** 



* Update product pricing, discounts, and commercial information based on approved price revisions from the Category and Procurement teams.
* Verify pricing accuracy before releasing updates to ensure error\-free quotations and customer proposals.
* Maintain historical pricing records and support periodic price revisions.



  





**4\. Product Launch Management:** 



* Coordinate the end\-to end catalogue readiness for new product launches, ensuring all product information, images, pricing, and documentation are available.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to ensure products are launched within committed timelines.
* Support the preparation of product launch materials, catalogues, and internal communication.



  





**5\. SKU Management:** 



* Create and maintain unique SKU codes for all products while ensuring there are no duplicate or incorrect entries.
* Update SKU mappings whenever products are modified, discontinued, or introduced.
* Maintain the master SKU database to support inventory, quotation, and reporting systems.



  





**6\. Quote Builder \& System Management:** 



* Coordinate with the Tech team to upload new products, pricing updates, and configuration changes into the Quote Builder and related systems.
* Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate data accuracy before system releases.
* Report and follow up on system issues to ensure minimal disruption to business operations.



  





**7\. Vendor Coordination:** 



* Liaise with vendors to collect product catalogues, images, specifications, pricing, warranty information, and other required documentation.
* Follow up with vendors to ensure timely submission of updated product information.
* Maintain organized records of all vendor documents and communications.



  





**8\. Documentation Management:** 



* Maintain and regularly update product rate cards, technical specifications, installation guidelines, comparison sheets, and other catalogue\-related documents.
* Ensure all documentation follows company standards and version control practices.
* Support the preparation of internal reference documents for Sales, Design, and Operations teams.



  





**9\. Cross\-Functional Coordination:** 



* Collaborate closely with Category, Procurement, Partners to ensure seamless catalogue updates.
* Communicate product changes, launches, and pricing revisions to relevant stakeholders in a timely manner.
* Support cross\-functional initiatives aimed at improving catalogue quality and business efficiency.



  





**10\. Catalogue Quality Control:** 



* Conduct regular audits to verify the accuracy of product information, pricing, images, specifications, and category mappings.
* Identify and resolve catalogue discrepancies before they impact customer quotations or project execution.
* Recommend process improvements to enhance catalogue accuracy, consistency, and operational efficiency.



  





**Educational Qualification:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Data Management or Information Management, or a related field.
* Experience in the Interior Industry is an added advantage.



  





**Experience:** 



* Minimum 2 years of experience in Catalogue Management, Product Management, Procurement Coordination, or Data Management.



  





**SKILLS REQUIRED:** 



* Advanced Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets
* Data Validation
* Basic ERP/CRM understanding
* Version Control Behavioural Skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to coordinate effectively with cross\-functional teams and external vendors
* High attention to detail and accuracy
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Process\-oriented with a focus on continuous improvement
* Ownership, accountability, and a proactive approach to work
* Adaptability and willingness to learn new systems and processes

title: Transformation Lead - AD
description:
**Role:** 
 Transformation Lead
   

  

**Business Vertical:** 
 IOA – Tech
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Hands\-on leader who acts as one of our most senior technical experts in the field. This is a unique, dual\-mission role. Externally, you will engage with our most strategic clients in a "forward\-deployed" capacity, leading technical workshops to design and integrate our data solutions into their complex ecosystems. Internally, you will use these client insights to architect and build the next generation of AI\-powered tools and workflows, radically optimizing our own data annotation processes. Your ultimate goal is to create an unbeatable competitive advantage by continuously improving our efficiency, quality, and delivery, directly reducing our clients' Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Client Solution Engineering \& Integration (External Focus)**
* Lead Technical Discovery \& Solution Design: Post\-sale, partner with the Solutioning team to lead deep\-dive technical workshops with clients. Deconstruct their current workflows, data challenges, and business objectives.
* Architect Custom Integration Plans: Design and map out how our platform and services will integrate seamlessly into the client's existing AI/ML pipelines and infrastructure.
* Act as the "Art of the Possible" Guide: Serve as the primary technical advisor to clients, demonstrating how our advanced capabilities, custom tools, and innovative workflows can solve their most difficult data challenges and accelerate their AI initiatives.
* Bridge to the Platform Team: Translate complex client requirements into precise technical specifications and user stories for our core Platform Deployment \& Management team, ensuring our platform roadmap is directly informed by real\-world client needs.
* Oversee Proofs of Concept (POCs): Lead and develop targeted POCs to prove the value and viability of our solutions within the client's environment, de\-risking large\-scale engagements.


**Internal Process Transformation \& Innovation (Internal Focus)**
* Drive Process Excellence: Be the owner of operational efficiency for our data annotation workforce. Continuously analyze our Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) workflows to identify and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Develop AI\-Powered "Co\-Pilots" and Accelerators: Architect, build, and deploy a portfolio of internal tools and intelligent agents that augment our human annotators. This includes automated quality checks, predictive assistance, and workflow\-agnostic automation scripts.
* Engineer "Safety Nets": Design and implement automated quality assurance (QA) systems and predictive monitoring to ensure we consistently exceed client SLAs for accuracy and throughput.
* Champion Human\-in\-the\-Loop Optimization: Leverage Generative AI, LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), and computer vision models to create systems that make our human workforce smarter, faster, and more accurate.
* Quantify Business Impact: Develop and maintain a framework to measure the ROI of your transformation initiatives, clearly demonstrating their impact on project margins, delivery speed, and client TCO.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* Experience: 14\+ years in a technology field, with at least 5 years in a senior, client\-facing technical role such as a Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, Professional Services Consultant, or Transformation Lead.
* Applied AI \& Process Automation: Proven, hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-grade AI/ML systems specifically for process automation and optimization. This is more important than pure research experience.
* Generative AI Stack Expertise: Deep, practical experience with the modern Generative AI stack, including LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), agentic frameworks, and vector databases. You must have built things with these technologies.
* Hybrid Skillset: A demonstrated ability to operate at the intersection of deep technology and business strategy. You must be able to write code and architect systems, but also create a compelling business case and present to a client executive.
* Cloud Architecture: Deep architectural expertise in one or more major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including their managed AI/ML services (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Consultative Mindset: A natural ability to listen, diagnose problems, and guide clients and internal teams toward elegant, effective solutions.
* Data Annotation Domain Knowledge: Direct experience with data annotation platforms, data quality challenges, and the operational dynamics of large\-scale data labeling workforces.
* Experience Building Internal Tools: A track record of identifying an internal business need and building a software solution to address it, driving measurable efficiency gains.
* An advanced degree (master's or PhD) in Computer Science, AI, or a related field is a strong plus.
* A portfolio of projects (e.g., GitHub) or detailed case studies demonstrating your work in building AI\-driven solutions.

title: Product Manager – AI Security
description:
**Location:** 
 India, Remote\-First
   

  

**Employment:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Start Date:** 
 November 2026 or February 2027
   

  

**Experience:** 
 5\+ years
   

  

**Language:** 
 Fluent English required
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Cybersecurity / Enterprise SaaS / AI Security
   

  

**About The Opportunity**
 Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a global enterprise cybersecurity company building a new generation of products to secure
 **AI agents, LLM\-powered applications, and the data they access** 
 .
   

  

 We're hiring
 **two technical Product Managers** 
 to own core areas of this new AI security platform.
   

  

 You'll join one of two workstreams:
   

  

* Cloud Discovery: Build a continuously updated inventory of the AI agents, models, and AI\-enabled applications running across customers' cloud environments, including the data and permissions they can access. This role requires strong knowledge of cloud platforms and cloud security.
* AI Security Platform: Own a core area of the platform across gateway, agentic security, forensics, or shared platform capabilities, working closely with engineering, security research, design, and enterprise customers.


 Both roles require a PM who has
 **shipped B2B security or infrastructure products** 
 , is technically comfortable working with engineering teams, and uses AI tools as part of their daily product workflow.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Own the roadmap, requirements, and prioritization for your product area from discovery through launch.
* Lead customer discovery with CISOs, security architects, and cloud/AI platform teams, translating customer needs into clear problem statements and PRDs.
* Partner with engineering and security research on scope, technical trade\-offs, and delivery, and participate in technical design reviews.
* Define success metrics and ensure the product measures adoption, coverage, and detection effectiveness.
* Work with product marketing, sales engineering, and support on positioning, enablement, and launches.
* Track the evolving AI security landscape, including agent frameworks, LLM providers, regulation, and competitors, and translate relevant developments into product strategy.
* Use AI tools and agentic workflows to accelerate research, analysis, documentation, and day\-to\-day product work.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 5\+ years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS, including 2\+ years working on security, cloud infrastructure, or developer\-facing products.
* Proven track record of shipping products used by enterprise security or infrastructure teams, with measurable outcomes.
* Strong technical fluency: comfortable reading API specifications, discussing distributed\-systems trade\-offs, and understanding how LLM applications and AI agents are deployed.
* Strong written communication and the ability to produce clear PRDs, decision documents, and executive updates.
* Practical, daily use of AI tools and LLM/agentic workflows in your own product work.
* Fluent English and comfortable collaborating with distributed teams across time zones.
* Strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast\-moving environment.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Product experience in cybersecurity, including DLP, CASB, SIEM, EDR, CSPM/CNAPP, or AI security.
* Strong practical knowledge of a major cloud provider, including services, IAM, and inventory/audit APIs.
* Engineering background or hands\-on scripting experience, particularly Python.
* Experience working with AI compliance and regulatory frameworks such as the EU AI Act or NIST AI RMF.
* Experience introducing AI\-assisted or agentic workflows into product teams.


 AI\-First Team
   

  

 AI is a core part of how this team works.
   

  

 During the interview process, you'll be asked about how you use AI in your own product work, including the tools you rely on, how you validate their output, and where AI has changed your workflow.
   

  

 We're looking for people who use AI as a
 **force multiplier for research, productivity, problem\-solving, and decision\-making** 
 , not simply as a writing or autocomplete tool.
   

  

 Why Join
   

  

* Shape a new product line at the intersection of cybersecurity and agentic AI.
* Work directly with engineering, security research, and enterprise customers on emerging security challenges.
* Own a significant product area with high visibility and influence.
* Help define how enterprises discover, understand, and secure AI systems.
* Join a highly technical, distributed team where AI is a core part of daily work.


 Pragmatike is committed to a fair, transparent, and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.
   

  

 In accordance with GDPR, your personal data will be processed lawfully, fairly, and securely and used solely for recruitment purposes, including sharing it with our client(s) for employment consideration.

title: Customer Value Lead
description:
**Do you have experience in managing innovation projects?**
**Are you a team Player?**
**About Our Team**
 The Customer Value Lead will sits within Journal Operations and is responsible for accelerating key strategic projects for Journal Operations, drive the right process and governance to drive Innovation across organization and contribute to development of key enablers such as learning ecosystem. .
   

  

**About The Role**
 Focused on core customer problems and an AI first mindset, the Customer Value Lead is accountable for driving the innovation initiatives, discovery, and value realisation of initiatives — including intelligent automation and Product capabilities — across end to end publishing processes.
   

  

 Acting as a strategic thought partner and accelerator for innovation, this role strengthens the quality of ideas and increases their likelihood of successful progression by challenging assumptions, quantifying value, surfacing risks and dependencies, connecting opportunities across domains, and providing structure and direction throughout discovery, product shaping, and implementation.Working closely with Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, and vendor teams, the role orchestrates delivery of prioritized initiatives across multiple stakeholders, resolves dependencies and blockers, and provides governance, decision\-making structure, and visibility to leadership.
   

  

 The role can also involve defining and tracking metrics and creating benefits frameworks, using experimentation and data to validate assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions, and ensures right prioritization of individual initiatives to deliver on our strategy.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Innovation Strategy, Initiatives \& Discovery**
* Assess new opportunities, establishing clear criteria for progression and prioritisation based on customer impact, business value, risk, and effort.
* Lead or consult on discovery activity, challenging the problem definition to ensure the right problem is being solved before investment is made.
* Define target outcomes, identify affected users and stakeholders, and quantify the potential impact of opportunities under consideration.
* Surface risks, assumptions, and dependencies early, and determine what needs to be validated (e.g. through research, prototyping, or experimentation) before an initiative progresses.


**Product Management \& Solution Shaping**
* Translate validated opportunities into clear product/solution requirements, defining journeys, outcomes, and success measures.
* Support prioritisation of requirements and features in partnership with Product and Technology, ensuring business value and customer impact drive sequencing.
* Work with Product and Technology teams through elaboration, design, and implementation, providing business input and decisions at key stages.
* Ensure delivered solutions remain aligned to the original business problem and intended outcomes, escalating and course\-correcting where scope or design drifts.
* Own business\-side delivery oversight, coordinating UAT, release readiness, and go\-live activities to ensure a smooth transition into live service.


**Intelligent Automation**
* Shape the roadmap for intelligent automation within the product, identifying where AI\-driven capabilities can most effectively support user tasks, decisions, or interactions, and building the business case for each opportunity.
* Partner with Technology and Design teams to define the underlying requirements — the logic, data and knowledge sources, and integration/API needs the capability depends on — along with the guardrails, escalation paths, and human\-in\-the\-loop or assisted\-service touchpoints needed to manage risk, edge cases, and complex scenarios.
* Establish clear quality and performance measures (such as accuracy, containment or resolution rates, error/escalation rates, and customer satisfaction), and agree the testing, validation, and release criteria required before deployment.
* Once live, monitor performance and usage data, incorporate user feedback, and drive continuous optimisation and retraining to ensure the capability keeps pace with changing needs and continues to deliver measurable value.


**Orchestration, Governance \& Delivery Acceleration**
* Act as the central connective point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, vendor, and other partner teams, resolving dependencies and unblocking delivery.
* Identify blockers and risks early, establish clear ownership, and drive decisions to keep initiatives moving when they span multiple teams.
* Establish and maintain operational governance to ensure enhancements align with service policies, compliance requirements, and readiness standards, communicating major changes and contingency plans clearly


- 

**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Value Realisation**
* Act as the central coordination point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, and other partner teams, facilitating alignment on priorities, service impacts, and adoption readiness across initiatives.
* Champion change enablement and adoption, ensuring capabilities are understood and effectively embedded into ways of working, and build a cross\-functional stakeholder community to share performance insights, lessons learned, and improvement opportunities.
* Establish baselines, targets, and KPI frameworks for initiatives, and maintain a benefits/impact monitoring framework to track value realised against the original business case.
* Track adoption, performance, quality, and other operational outcomes, using data and structured experimentation to test assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions.
* Escalate operational risks, dependency conflicts, and delivery blockers through appropriate governance channels, and connect insights and outcomes across initiatives to identify opportunities for reuse or broader strategic alignment.


**Requirements**
* 6–10 years of experience in service operations, digital support operations, automation initiatives, or business\-facing roles within technology\-enabled environments.
* Demonstrated experience delivering measurable improvements in service efficiency, operational performance, and customer satisfaction.
* Experience identifying and evaluating automation or digital enhancement opportunities from a business and service impact perspective.
* Strong understanding of customer support operations, including case management workflows, escalation models, SLAs, and service risk considerations.
* Experience partnering with Product and Technology teams to translate operational priorities into structured business requirements and improvement initiatives.
* Proven ability to drive adoption of digital tools or automation capabilities within operational environments.
* Strong analytical and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to translate performance insights into clear recommendations.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations Management, Engineering, Technology, or a related field. Relevant certifications (Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, ITIL, Service Management) are advantageous.


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.
   

  

* Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive


**Working for you**
**Benefits**
 We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
   

  

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents.
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.
* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work\-life balance.
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work\-related challenges.
* Medical Screening: Your well\-being is a top priority.
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
* Long\-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
* Free Transport pick up and drop from the home \-office \- home (applies in Chennai)

 A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals’ advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

title: SME-Product info & MDM
description:
**Job Summary**
 This hybrid night shift role focuses on managing product information and master data to support efficient order management and trading operations for an MNC. The SME will optimize data flows between systems ensure accuracy of product and order records and collaborate with cross functional teams to improve retail order processes. The role contributes directly to customer satisfaction and stable trading performance by maintaining reliable data foundations and supporting continuous improvement a
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive end to end ownership of product information and master data flows for order management and trading systems ensuring accurate synchronized data across core platforms to support consistent execution and reliable reporting
* Manage creation update and maintenance of product master records including attributes hierarchies pricing and availability so that downstream order and trading processes operate with clean structured data
* Coordinate closely with order management operations teams to analyze data issues impacting order capture fulfillment and settlement and implement corrective actions that prevent recurrence and reduce manual interventions
* Collaborate with trading and commercial stakeholders to define data rules for item setup bundle management and promotional constructs ensuring that business strategies are reflected reliably in system configurations
* Monitor nightly data loads and interface jobs across hybrid environments addressing exceptions in near real time to secure uninterrupted processing and timely visibility for global teams
* Design and maintain data quality checks and validation routines that detect anomalies in product and order data enabling early remediation and continuous improvement of master data standards
* Document functional data models for order management and trading processes translating complex concepts into clear reference materials that support onboarding and knowledge sharing across teams
* Partner with technology teams to refine mapping logic between product information management master data management and order platforms focusing on performance scalability and resilience of integrations
* Support incident analysis for data related defects in night shift operations providing structured root cause insights and proposing pragmatic solutions that enhance customer experience and operational stability
* Contribute to process optimization initiatives across retail order flows by proposing enhancements to data structures configuration rules and workflows that reduce cycle times and improve order accuracy
* Engage with stakeholders in hybrid working sessions to gather requirements for new product and order data capabilities and convert them into well defined specifications that guide implementation and testing
* Perform impact assessments for product and master data changes across reporting billing and trading processes ensuring that dependencies are understood and that transitions are executed safely without disruption
* Promote adoption of master data governance practices through clear communication of standards guidance on best practices and active participation in forums that strengthen data discipline across the organization


**Qualifications**
* Possess four to seven years of hands on experience as a subject matter expert in product information and master data within complex order management and trading environments demonstrating strong ownership of data outcomes
* Bring solid practical expertise working with core order management platforms and trading systems including configuration troubleshooting and data analysis to keep high volume operations running smoothly
* Apply demonstrated exposure to retail order management scenarios such as omnichannel ordering and inventory visibility translating domain understanding into better data design and process alignment
* Show capability in documenting requirements user stories and data dictionaries in a clear and structured manner making it easier for cross functional teams to deliver enhancements and maintain solutions
* Demonstrate strong analytical skills using data profiling and issue analysis techniques to identify root causes of product and order data problems and to recommend sustainable corrective actions
* Operate effectively in a hybrid work model and dedicated night shift environment maintaining proactive communication and coordination with onshore and offshore partners without needing travel
* Exhibit familiarity with master data management principles including governance stewardship and lifecycle management applying them to improve reliability and reusability of product and order data assets

title: Consultant, Customer Experience & Business Process Improvement (CX&BPI)
description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work.
